content.short: Freename provides Web3 domains and TLDs.
content.description: Freename is a multichain Web3 domain provider supporting Polygon, BSC (BNB Chain), Aurora, and Solana. It helps you create, mint, and own a Web3 domain, giving you a portable on-chain name you control across networks. With Freename you can build and connect a Web3 website, enable on-chain payments, establish your own Web3 identity linked to your domain, and list that domain on OpenSea to showcase it.
